name: revnil
description: REVNIL — Multi-tenant ERP platform for collegiate athletics management

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=app && npm run typecheck --workspace=functions
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run build:functions && firebase deploy
scripts.ci:build: npm run build && npm run build:functions
scripts.ci:test: npm run test:rules:ci && npm run test:unit
scripts.ci:verify: npm run ci:lint && npm run ci:typecheck && npm run ci:build && npm run ci:test
scripts.test:rules:ci: firebase emulators:exec --project nil-rev-dev --only firestore "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts --reporter=dot"
